speaker: SPEAKER_01
transcript: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Style That Finds Us Podcast. We are excited to have former United States Representative Carolyn Maloney on the Style That Finds Us Podcast today. Congressman Maloney was the first woman to represent New York City's 7th Council District, where she was the first woman to also give birth in office. She was the first woman to chair the Joint Economic Committee. She became the first woman to chair the House Committee on Oversight and Reform. She was the first to offer a comprehensive package of legislation to make daycare more available and affordable. She introduced a bill to establish permanent authorization of the September 11th Victim Compensation Fund Act, which was signed into law. She advocated to provide Medicare coverage for annual mammograms. Congressman Maloney has introduced and advocated for legislation regarding issues such as sexual assaults, sex trafficking, women's rights, and child care to name a few. She played a role in getting an American Women's History Museum on the National Mall and is advocating for the Equal Rights Amendment. Thank you, Congresswoman Maloney, for everything you have done and fought for. And thank you for being here with us today.
